sections.title: 1. Information We Receive
sections.content: We may receive information you voluntarily provide when you contact the clinic, request an appointment, or submit an online form. This can include your name, contact details and appointment-related information.

sections.title: 2. How Information Is Used
sections.content: Information is used to respond to inquiries, coordinate appointments, communicate with patients and provide the services requested from the clinic.

sections.title: 3. WhatsApp and Third-Party Services
sections.content: If you choose to use WhatsApp, Google Forms, maps, social media or other third-party services, those services may process information according to their own privacy policies and terms.

sections.title: 4. Medical Information
sections.content: This website is not intended to replace direct medical evaluation. Do not submit sensitive medical information through a public form unless the clinic specifically instructs you to do so.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.content: The clinic should define its own retention period and record-handling practices here. Replace this section with the clinic's actual policy before publication.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.content: For privacy questions, contact the clinic using the contact details published on this website.

sections.title: 1. Website Purpose
sections.content: This website provides general clinic information, patient education and appointment-request options for a private medical practice.

sections.title: 2. No Emergency Care
sections.content: This website and its forms are not an emergency medical service. If you have a medical emergency, seek appropriate emergency care immediately.

sections.title: 3. Appointment Requests
sections.content: Submitting an appointment request does not by itself guarantee an appointment. The clinic must confirm availability and the appointment time.

sections.title: 4. Patient Education
sections.content: Educational articles, videos and messages are provided for general information and should not be treated as individualized diagnosis or treatment instructions.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Links
sections.content: Links to WhatsApp, Google Forms, Google Maps, YouTube and social networks are provided for convenience. Third-party services operate under their own terms and policies.

sections.title: 6. Changes
sections.content: The clinic may update website content, services, hours and these terms when necessary. The clinic should replace this template language with its final legal text before publication.
